statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service was ordered to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias that may be contributing to embolic events
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-97
The denial reason is that the requested service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
